name: Disco Corporation
price_source: StockAnalysis.com (TYO:6146) quote, cross-checked vs companiesmarketcap.com ($60.19B USD mcap) and JSON (JPY 88,480)
owner_fcf_base: Owner FCF FY2026 = reported FCF JPY 98.4B - SBC ~0 (immaterial / not separately disclosed for this Japanese precision-equipment maker) = JPY 98.4B (~JPY 907/share). Note: reported FCF understates earnings power (FY26 net income JPY 135.5B) because capex is elevated during the AI/HBM-driven expansion; this depresses the pure-DCF result.

conservador.note: Phase1 CAGR 5%, Phase2 declining to 3%, g_term 2.5%. AI dicing/grinding demand normalizes off peak; capex stays high. Reasonable-pessimistic, not apocalyptic. Equity = EV + net cash JPY 284B. TV ~61% of EV.

base.note: Phase1 CAGR 10%, Phase2 declining to 5%, g_term 3.0%. Structural AI/HBM/GPU dicing & grinding tailwind sustains double-digit growth then matures. WACC 8.05%. TV ~67%.

optimista.note: Phase1 CAGR 16%, Phase2 declining to 8%, g_term 3.5%. AI semicap supercycle extends, Disco's near-monopoly in precision dicing/grinding compounds at high ROIC. TV ~73%.

multiple_rationale: Anchored to the 5y avg forward P/E of 30x with a small uplift to 32x crediting a genuine structural mix improvement (AI/HBM/GPU dicing & grinding is a secular step-up in demand and value-add, not purely cyclical). But a large haircut is applied vs the spot 53.2x, which reflects cyclical-peak euphoria at an all-time high (also far above the ~28x 10y TTM median). Fwd EPS ~JPY 1,683 (consistent with reported fwd P/E 53.17 on a price of 89,490; implies FY27 NI ~JPY 182B vs FY26 135.5B) x 32 = JPY 53,859.
structural_change: Positive but partly cyclical: generative-AI / HBM / advanced-packaging demand for precision wafer dicing and grinding is a real secular step-up in Disco's addressable market and product mix (Disco holds a near-monopoly here). This justifies a fair multiple modestly above the 5y average. However, it does NOT justify the spot 53x; semicap remains cyclical and high-capex, and Disco itself refuses to issue full-year guidance citing demand volatility. No structural deterioration — the concern is valuation, not franchise quality.
sanity_notes: Price JPY 89,490 (StockAnalysis Jun 23 2026); JSON had 88,480 (Jun 22) — used the fresher verified figure, immaterial difference. Shares 108.46M = 0.10846B. Implied mcap = 89,490 x 108.46M = JPY 9.706T; /161.54 USD/JPY = $60.08B USD, matching companiesmarketcap.com ($60.19B) and JSON ($59.4B) — scale CONFIRMED. DISCARDED an erroneous Yahoo-derived $43.29B (implied stale FX ~224). USD/JPY = 161.54 verified (Jun 22 2026). Magnitude check: reconciled IV JPY 40,272 sits within the 30-300% band (26,847-268,470), so no units/currency/shares error. Weighting tilted to DCF (0.6/0.4) because Disco is cyclical, high-capex, and demand-volatile (no full-year guidance) — the multiple anchor alone would overstate IV by extrapolating peak conditions. Both methods independently flag overvaluation: DCF IV ~31k, multiple IV ~54k, reconciled ~40k vs price ~89k => stock trades ~2x reconciled fair value, a quality franchise at a cyclical-peak multiple near all-time highs. SBC left at 0 (immaterial/undisclosed); net cash JPY 284B added to EV in all DCF scenarios.
